nixos_mode.label: NixOS configuration monitor
nixos_mode.description: Watch /etc/nixos (following its symlink to your config checkout) with the title "NixOS Config" and a snowflake glyph. Hides the title and repository path settings.

title.label: Title
title.description: Name shown in the panel header, the tooltip and notifications. Leave blank to show the repository path.

repo_path.label: Repository path
repo_path.description: Git checkout this dot watches (for example ~/src/project). The dot stays inactive until this is set.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Icon drawn instead of the dot, to tell several dots apart. Leave empty for the dot (a snowflake in NixOS mode). Colored by status like the dot.

poll_interval_s.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval_s.description: Fallback git status check for every watched repository. File changes are also picked up immediately via inotify.

fetch_interval_min.label: Fetch interval (minutes)
fetch_interval_min.description: How often to git fetch each repository to detect when its upstream is ahead. 0 disables fetching.

hide_when_clean.label: Hide when clean
hide_when_clean.description: Hide the dot when there are no uncommitted changes and the branch is not behind its upstream. A misconfigured dot is always shown.

show_count.label: Show file count
show_count.description: Show the number of uncommitted files next to the dot.

right_click_refresh.label: Right-click to fetch
right_click_refresh.description: Right-clicking the dot runs git fetch and refreshes the status without opening the panel.
